text:
jose_cs: Heads-up: Beacon Health onboarding showing sudden embedding-heavy traffic since last night, approx 2.9x token burn. Need short-term guardrails and a QBR note.
ivy_finops: Can we get a quick per-route snapshot and 7-day projection if current rate holds?
tess_se: Console: /v1/embeddings = 81% of tokens; current pace ~1.5M tokens/day -> 7d ~10.5M. Likely caused by their nightly reindex job.
jose_cs: Requests: 1) temporary budget cushion + alerts, 2) soft throttle on embeddings route, 3) enable caching or switch to snapshot run, 4) schedule 30-min enablement tomorrow.
ivy_finops: Propose 15% credit cushion and alerts at 65%/85% of cushion. I'll calculate cost impact for the QBR slide.
mike_enable: I can run enablement — will cover batching, sampling index windows, and using partial refreshes rather than full reindex. Morning CT ok?
tess_se: Quick mitigation done: set route cap 700k tokens/day and enabled snapshot mode for the indexer. Monitoring metrics now.
ops-bot: Alert created "beacon-embed-burn-65-85" (ID: OP-4421). Follow-up reminder in 24h (1812348600).
ivy_finops: Cushion provisioned. Adding note to account: "temp cushion until follow-up" and will include token-to-dollar delta on slide.
jose_cs: Draft slide copy: "Root cause: full reindex created dense embedding calls; Mitigation: snapshot reindex + route cap + enablement; Outcome: expected burn reduced to ~0.5M tokens/day."
mike_enable: Will record the session and attach a one-page playbook (batch size examples, TTL suggestions).
jose_cs: Assign owners: ivy_finops -> cushion + slide numbers, tess_se -> caps + cache (monitoring), mike_enable -> enablement. Reassess renewal-risk after 24h. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
